hypothesis.claim: The central rose contains a structurally verifiable 3 + 7 + 12 = 22 organization relevant to its field topology.

separationRule: The central rose is an independent topology domain. Outer 72-sector polar boundaries MUST NOT be extended through the rose merely to manufacture fields.

pathResearch.principle: If source-supported letter/symbol sequences traverse rose cells, represent the traversal as an ordered path over measured rose fields rather than as freehand geometry.

promotionRule: Only measured rose regions become CR-MF candidates. They receive AK identities only after adjacency/topology is stable under G4.

integrationTarget.unification: knowledge graph edges between independently measured domains
integrationTarget.pixelRule: A future HNK pixel/isopixel references the canonical field identity regardless of whether that field originated in outer polar topology or central rose topology.
